integrity: The asymptotic limit is established by monomial derivative factorization and a bounded martingale central limit theorem. Computations are supplementary; no independent examination has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed integer dimension; normalized Lebesgue initial data; a.e. differentiability; singular values rather than periodic multiplier eigenvalues; no joint growing-dimension limit or independent validation.
title: Multinomial Gaussian singular-spectrum law for the twisted baker map
